title: 第一章 烈火重生，重回及笄前
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

烈火燎原，滚烫的火舌疯狂吞噬着破旧冷院。

浓烟呛得人肺腑生疼，灼烧皮肉的剧痛，是沈清鸢此生最刻骨铭心的绝望。

她被铁链锁在冰冷的石柱上，衣衫破败，满身伤痕。

院外，传来她最疼爱的庶妹沈轻柔娇柔又恶毒的笑声：

“姐姐，你看，这漫天大火，多适合送你上路啊。”

“你的婚约、你的嫡女身份、你爹娘的性命、整个丞相府的荣耀……从今往后，全都是我的。”

一旁的太子萧景渊，是她倾尽整个青春去爱慕、去追随的良人。

此刻，他眼神冷漠，毫无半分怜惜。

“沈清鸢，你骄纵善妒、心肠歹毒，不配为太子妃，更不配活在这世间。丞相府通敌叛国，满门抄斩，你死有余辜。”

通敌叛国？

沈清鸢笑得凄厉，血泪从眼角滚落。

她沈家世代忠良，鞠躬尽瘁辅佐大启王朝，何来通敌叛国！

这一切，都是沈轻柔与萧景渊联手布下的滔天骗局！

是她瞎了眼！

错信蛇蝎庶妹，错付薄情太子！

害娘亲含冤而死，害爹爹惨死刑场，害整个百年相府，覆灭殆尽！

烈火席卷而来，吞噬她最后的意识。

弥留之际，沈清鸢用尽最后一丝力气，咬牙泣血立誓：

“若有来生——我沈清鸢！定要你们二人！血、债、血、偿！！”

“小姐！小姐您醒醒！”

轻柔焦急的呼唤在耳边响起。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

A raging fire set the prairie fire ablaze, and the scalding tongues of flames crazily devoured the dilapidated cold courtyard.

The thick smoke made people's lungs hurt, and the severe pain that burned the flesh was the most unforgettable despair in Shen Qingyuan's life.

She was chained to a cold stone pillar, her clothes were torn and her body was covered in scars.

Outside the hospital, the soft and vicious laughter of her most beloved concubine Shen Qingrou came:

"Sister, look, this huge fire is perfect for sending you on your way."

"Your engagement, your status as a legitimate daughter, the lives of your parents, the glory of the entire Prime Minister's Palace...from now on, they are all mine."

The prince Xiao Jinyuan beside her was the man she had spent her entire youth admiring and following.

At this moment, his eyes were cold and devoid of any pity.

"Shen Qingyuan, you are arrogant, jealous, and evil-hearted. You are not worthy of being a crown princess, let alone living in this world. The Prime Minister's Mansion collaborated with the enemy and treason, and everyone in the family was executed. You deserve to die."

Collaboration with the enemy and treason?

Shen Qingyuan laughed miserably, tears of blood rolling down from the corners of his eyes.

She, the Shen family, has been loyal for generations and has devoted her whole life to assisting the Daqi Dynasty. How can she collaborate with the enemy and treason!

All of this is a huge scam set up by Shen Qingrou and Xiao Jamyuan!

She is blind!

Wrongly trusting a snake and scorpion concubine, wrongly paying for a ruthless prince!

It caused my mother to die unjustly, caused my father to suffer a tragic death penalty, and caused the entire century-old prime minister's mansion to be completely destroyed!

The fire swept over her and swallowed up her last consciousness.

On his deathbed, Shen Qingyuan used up his last bit of strength, gritted his teeth and wept blood and swore:

"If there is an afterlife - I, Shen Qingyuan! I will definitely demand the two of you! Blood, debt, blood, pay!!"

"Miss! Miss, wake up!"

A soft and anxious call sounded in my ears.
